label: D2 after a rewarded previous trial (stronger in S1 / a1, builds over reward streaks)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and only when the previous trial was rewarded: 99.6% of activations and 99.9% of activation mass fall in D2 & prev_reward==1. It never fires at D1 or GO, and never after an unrewarded previous trial. But only about 15% of those steps are active, so this is a necessary condition with low precision. Magnitude and firing rate depend on: (a) choosing a1 and reaching S1, which holds about 75-78% of the mass; (b) runs of consecutive rewards, where activation ramps up from one trial to the next across rewarded a1->S1c trials and the strongest examples come after long rewarded streaks; (c) episode time, rising from ~0.5x in trials 0-9 to 1.5x in trials 60-79 and then dropping to 0.2x in trials 90-99; (d) high value and the D2 policy logit leaning toward a2 (choice < 2.78 always, and it is almost never active when choice > 2.78). The best refinement, D2 & prev_reward==1 & in_state==S1 & choice<0, reached dev F1 0.46 (P 0.33, R 0.73, mass 0.78). I recorded the simpler gating predicate because it covers essentially all of the mass. It uses only observed variables.
